A '''species''' of [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Eel/Legends|eel]] could be found in the waters of the planet [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. They had eight [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and at least three fins, one of which was a dorsal fin. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dass Jennir]] encountered a member of this [[Species/Legends|species]] after escaping from the [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ken-Kiba]]'s and his [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang|spice runner gang]] through a trap door in the floor of the brothel known as [[Ember's Fire]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Noua]]. The eel emerged from amongst some rocks and attempted to devour Jennir while he was submerged, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] narrowly escaped when he was pulled to safety by a local fisherman named [[Fish (Human)|Fish]].<ref name="DT16" />

==Behind the scenes==
The eel species first appeared in the [[Dark Times 16|fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: Blue Harvest|''Blue Harvest'']] story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the name Mike Harrison and illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]]. Released in [[2010]], the issue did not the name the species or make clear its level of [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]].
